numpy.smoke:
import numpy as np
a = np.array([[3., 1.], [1., 2.]])
np.testing.assert_allclose(a @ a, [[10., 5.], [5., 5.]])
np.testing.assert_allclose(a @ np.linalg.solve(a, [1., 0.]), [1., 0.], atol=1e-14)
assert np.test(label='fast', tests=['numpy.linalg.tests'], verbose=1)

dwave-optimization.smoke:
from dwave.optimization import Model
import dwave.optimization.symbols
model = Model()
x = model.binary(3)
model.minimize(x.sum())
model.states.resize(1)
with model.lock():
    x.set_state(0, [1, 0, 1])
    assert model.objective.state(0) == 2
